items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: Robert has collaborated with a diverse list of artists including Terence Blanchard, Christian McBride, Kanye West and MeShell Ndegeocello

ctx.x: Pianist and composer Robert Glasper has demonstrated one path that the 21st century jazz artist can follow. His melding of R&B, hip hop and jazz has proved highly successful, both critically and in the marketplace. Robert has collaborated with a diverse list of artists including Terence Blanchard, Christian McBride, Kanye West and MeShell Ndegeocello and he currently leads his own piano trio.
Robert was interviewed in Clinton, NY on February 20, 2016 by Greg Thomas, Hamilton class of ‘85.
